"Generates a time-limited signature for secure file uploads to SPOTIO storage .
                After getting the response upload file like this (provide your file, and use response data):
                curl -F "UPLOADCARE_PUB_KEY=response.publicKey" \
                     -F "signature=response.signature" \
                     -F "expire=response.expire" \
                     -F "file=@yourfile.jpg" \
                     "response.uploadUrl"
